# club.fernan.api

> Drop-in Java client for the fernan.club REST API. JDK 17+, single
> transitive dependency (Gson), async-first via `CompletableFuture`.
> Designed to be embedded in Minecraft mods, launchers, or any JVM
> application — and structured so that AI coding assistants can integrate
> it confidently in a single pass.

The library exposes one entry point (`FernanClient`) and five typed services
(`user`, `store`, `refunds`, `referrals`, `health`). All failures surface
through a single `FernanException` carrying a typed `ErrorType` enum.
Referral codes are gated behind an explicit `ReferralChoice` value type so
agents cannot silently apply a default. See `CLAUDE.md` for the full
AI-integration guide.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/README.md): Overview, install, quickstart, services map.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CLAUDE.md): Integration guide written for AI assistants. Covers patterns, pitfalls, threading.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): PR workflow, Conventional Commits, coding conventions.
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CHANGELOG.md): Released versions and unreleased plans.

## Examples

- [MinimalExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/MinimalExample.java): Smallest possible "build client, fetch user, print balance" program.
- [AltManagerExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/AltManagerExample.java): Canonical alt-storage integration — list stock, validate referral, purchase, decode credentials, hand off to a host-app `AltStore` interface.
- [ErrorHandlingExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/ErrorHandlingExample.java): Retry-aware handling for `RATE_LIMITED`, `COOLDOWN`, and `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`.

## Core source

- [FernanClient.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/FernanClient.java): Top-level facade exposing the five services.
- [FernanClientBuilder.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/FernanClientBuilder.java): Builder with `apiKey`, `userAgent`, `integration`, `baseUrl`, `connectTimeoutMillis`, `onApiKeyChange`, `executor`.
- [FernanException.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/exception/FernanException.java): Single exception class for all API errors.
- [ErrorType.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/exception/ErrorType.java): Enum of error categories — switch on this rather than HTTP status codes.
- [ReferralChoice.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/model/referral/ReferralChoice.java): Explicit caller decision type. Use `ReferralChoice.of(code)` or `ReferralChoice.none()` — never null-default.
- [IntegrationSignal.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/integration/IntegrationSignal.java): Partner-attribution header set via `FernanClientBuilder.integration("my-app")`.

## Services

- [UserService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/UserService.java): `me`, `apiKey`, `regenerateApiKey` (silently updates client auth + fires `onApiKeyChange`), `redeemKey`.
- [StoreService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/StoreService.java): `stock`, `cooldowns`, `purchase`, `purchases`, `purchaseDetail`, `validateReferral`.
- [RefundService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/RefundService.java): `create`, `cancel`, `list`, `get`.
- [ReferralService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/ReferralService.java): `create`, `list`, `stats`, `toggle`, `delete` (MediaPlus+ only).
- [HealthService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/HealthService.java): `get`, `simple`.
